scope: Exactly existing N1, N3, N2 work items; no old timeout or default screening reruns on the old engine
comparison_engine: 2.1.289; conditional on official download and manifest checksum verification
constraints: No model calls/login/auth changes, no global CLI/settings changes, no canceled projects, no automatic issue/release
source_hash_registration: The runner records source mod, unchanged functional hooks, authored test and executed overlay SHA256 before each native test invocation; data captures and raw logs remain private.

N1.injection: Change only userConfig.instructionFiles.default in a fresh private manifest; options list and hooks source unchanged. This tests initial option selection, not persisted settings or hot reload.
N1.fixture: Actual synthetic root/nested AGENTS and CLAUDE files plus managed/user/local/memory instruction entries handed explicitly through test hooks

criteria.claude-md: Handed instruction list stays intact, nested AGENTS does not attach, no instruction walk is requested
criteria.claude-md-and-agents-md: Root AGENTS is added beside handed CLAUDE, nested AGENTS also attaches where a nested CLAUDE exists, imported AGENTS path is not duplicated
criteria.managed-only: Only managed and memory instruction kinds remain, no nested AGENTS attaches, already supplied tool context is preserved

N1.unchanged_assertions: All context/list/path/byte equality and walk assertions retained across repetitions; default 5000 ms test deadlines

N3.fixture: Fresh ordinary and linked repositories; actual entry kinds, HEAD/ref/log/packed-ref file text and unmodified filesystem timestamps
cases: Two unchanged captures: same object ID and equal key
Commit on the same ordinary branch: changed object ID and changed key
Checkout a diverged branch: changed HEAD text/object ID and changed key
Detach HEAD at current commit: unchanged object ID, changed HEAD representation/key
Pack refs: unchanged object ID, changed ref/packed-refs representation/key
Commit in linked worktree: changed shared ref/object ID/key with unchanged own HEAD bytes
Commit on a non-ASCII branch: changed object ID and changed key via the documented timestamp/fallback route
N3.oracle: git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD for identity; filesystem stat nanoseconds captured with millisecond values passed to unchanged headKeyOf. No os.utime, sleeps to force distinct stamps, synthetic timestamp injection or permission bypass.
N3.scope: Source refresh probe with captured filesystem/Git replies, not production polling, UI refresh or process/filesystem transport

N2.acquisition: Official downloads.claude.ai release archive, pinned win32-x64 2.1.289, size and SHA256 against manifest. Do not run installer or modify global launchers; use explicit executable path and child-only update/traffic guards.
N2.comparison: Run the existing 18 authored free-screen assertions unchanged against two fresh fixtures on 2.1.289. Historical 2.1.288 records remain separate controls; no rescue/fix effect if both versions pass.
N2.unavailable: Record HTTP/checksum/runtime error metadata if blocked; do not silently substitute another version; complete N1/N3 first

classification: A differing functional assertion is a component signal, not automatically an E3/E4 production bug. Preserve invalid harness/configuration/timeout records and counterexamples; escalate only an actual signal. Gate remains closed without minimal current-production reproduction, duplicate check and independent review.
privacy: No raw native log, source implementation, actual absolute path, user identity or complete capture exported. Publish inspected counts, closed mode choices, relations and hashes only.
